item.title: [Ada Derana Biz English] High Grown Tea Production Slumps to an All-Time Low
item.description:
Preliminary tea production data released by the Sri Lanka Tea Board confirms that September 2026 production declined to 20.2 Mnkg, down by nearly 9% compared with 22.1 Mnkg recorded in September 2025.

item.title: [Daily FT - Business/Sectors] High Grown tea output sinks to 34-year low in September
item.description: Sri Lanka’s tea production fell by nearly 9% year-on-year in September to 20.2 MnKg, from 22.1 MnKg a year earlier, as excessive rainfall and poor growing conditions dragged High Grown output down to its lowest level in 34 years, Asia Siyaka Commodities PLC said, citing preliminary data from the Sri Lanka Tea Board.
